g.text: Overfit — Evaluation Architecture
Four kinds of probe against seven layers: what each can measure, what it costs, and which failures it is blind to.
PIPELINE LAYER
the seam being probed
An empty cell is information:
that probe is blind to that layer.
T0 · INVARIANTS
free · pytest
Boolean. Deterministic assertions that
must never change.
T1 · INTRINSIC METRICS
free · no labels
Readings. Statistics of the corpus itself,
no ground truth needed.
T2 · GOLDEN SET
30–50 items, by hand
recall@k · MRR. A question, and the
passage that answers it.
T3 · JUDGEMENT
per item · human or LLM
Is the answer actually supported by the
passage it cites?
Loader
ingestion/loader.py
Extension filter applied. A missing courses dir
raises, rather than yielding an empty index.
Files indexed vs ignored, by extension.
Parser
ingestion/parser.py
A PDF with no text layer is a hard failure
(is_empty), never an empty document flowing on.
Chars per page · blank-page rate · figure-residue
rate, expected ~1%. That is the known ceiling of
regex cleaning, so a jump means something
changed.
Chunker
ingestion/chunker.py
make_id stable across runs · week1/notes and
week2/notes do not collide · overlap loses no
characters at a boundary.
Chunk length distribution against the 250-token
target · share under 200 chars, i.e. how much of
the corpus selection's floor makes ineligible.
Embedder
embedding.py
‖v‖ = 1 ± 1e-6. The store's score formula is exact
only while this holds — assert it, do not just
comment it.
Dimension agreement with meta · zero and NaN
vectors.
Vector Store
storage/store.py
add() idempotent on re-run · count(chunks) =
count(vec_chunks) · a profile mismatch raises
IndexMismatchError instead of degrading quietly.
Cache hit rate — file-level, not chunk-level:
editing one page still re-embeds the whole file.
Retriever
query/retriever.py + selection.py
score ∈ [0,1] and equals exact cosine · MMR's λ
has real effect after rescaling: λ=0 reproduces
plain top-k, λ=1 ignores the query entirely.
Top-k score spread · pairwise similarity of the
selected material (redundancy) · document and
topic coverage of one exam's worth of material.
recall@5 · MRR · rank of the passage you know is
correct. The only cell that puts a number on the
ceiling — and so the only one that can say
whether re-ranking or hybrid search is worth
building. Must contain adversarial
near-neighbours.
Generator
query/generator.py
_coerce takes a bare array and an aliased wrapper
· a missing source is still refused · absent items ≠
empty items · all three response_format rungs
validate identically.
Attempts per run · citations dropped · repeated
questions and topics within one paper.
Three questions per item. Is the answer supported
by the passage it cites? Is the question
self-contained? Is it worth examining? Distinct
from _drop_invented_citations, which only proves
the citation points somewhere real.
Reading order — why there is no single score
Failures compound downstream, so one end-to-end number cannot tell you where to work.
T0 red
→ stop. Nothing in the columns to its right means anything yet.
T1 abnormal
→ a data problem — extraction or chunking, never the model.
T2 low
→ retrieval is the ceiling. This number is what decides whether re-ranking or hybrid search is worth building,
instead of guessing.
T2 high, T3 low
→ the model was handed the right material and ignored it. The only failure in the whole pipeline
that is about the model.
Two traps in the golden set — decide before labelling, not after
Anchor on (source, page), not chunk id.
Ids carry an in-page counter — c{index} — so changing chunk_size silently repoints every label at different text.
Store the IndexProfile fingerprint with the set and warn on mismatch, the way the store already refuses a
mismatched index.
Sample the near-neighbour failure, not around it.
"What is overfitting" and a passage defining underfitting sit close in embedding space and opposite in meaning. A set
without those pairs reports a recall the system has not earned, and hides the exact gap re-ranking exists to close.
